title: Hiring Panel answers (work/answers.json)
description: The ONE question batch (at most 7 questions; the builder interview for thin resumes allows 8) and the candidate's replies, verbatim. Order: integrity confirmations, then one combined keywords question (yes/some/no per term), then number placeholders, then reviewer questions. Rewrite evidence cites these as Q1, Q2... Only status 'answered' counts as evidence; for kind 'keywords' items answered 'yes' or 'some' count (term + detail), and the rest of the reply can back other facts, but a term answered 'no' never counts. See references/questions.md.

mode.description: skipped = the candidate replied 'skip' (every answer then has status 'skipped').

answer.description: The candidate's words, verbatim (keep 'about', ranges and typos). null when skipped.

items.description: Only for kind 'keywords': one entry per term in the combined list.

detail.description: Where and how they used it, in their words. For a 'no', any other words they volunteered ('no, but I did the CITI human subjects training'), or ''. Those words can back OTHER facts; the term answered 'no' itself is never evidence.
